defects.description: An explicitly supplied zero retry count incorrectly inherits the base count.
defects.why_missed: A naive oracle equates the zero value with absence, or overlays onto a zero base, yielding identical results across variants (S9d).

defects.description: An explicitly supplied false enabled flag incorrectly inherits true.
defects.why_missed: An empty-base test of false passes every variant; a default-oriented oracle mistakes an explicit disabling value for an absent field (S9d).
